steps.en: Install the package with a backend extra
steps.code: pip install timesfm[torch] · pip install timesfm[mlx]

steps.en: Point the model config at the Hugging Face checkpoint
steps.zh: 把模型配置指向 HF 上的 checkpoint

steps.en: Loads pretrained weights — no training job, no per-series fitting
steps.zh: 加载预训练权重——零训练任务、零逐序列拟合

steps.en: Hand it the raw history and a horizon
steps.zh: 把原始历史和预测步长交给它

steps.en: Returns point forecast plus 9 quantile bands; multivariate and covariates native since 3.0
steps.zh: 返回点预测加 9 条分位数带；3.0 起原生支持多变量与协变量

value.en: Forecasts for whole fleets of series from one pretrained model, run locally — no training pipeline, no cloud per-call bill
value.zh: 一个预训练模型预测整批序列，全程本地跑——不建训练管线，不付云 API 账单
